title: Bounding μ_T for Noninvertible-Feedback TtP Constructions
summary: Prior bounds cover TtP constructions with invertible decryption feedback, but a useful upper bound for the noninvertible case, including keyed Sponge Duplex and Ascon, remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: Determine a useful upper bound on the quantity $\mu_T$ for Transform-then-Permute (TtP) constructions with a noninvertible decryption feedback function, particularly keyed Sponge Duplex and Ascon constructions; bounding $\mu_T$ under this condition remains open.

scope.domain: The domain is symmetric authenticated encryption, with security analysis of Transform-then-Permute constructions such as keyed Sponge Duplex and Ascon.
assumptions: the decryption feedback function is noninvertible
parameters: μ_T, the quantity for which a useful upper bound is sought
scope.unresolved_remainder: A useful upper bound on μ_T for the noninvertible-feedback TtP case, particularly for keyed Sponge Duplex and Ascon, remains unresolved.

progress.summary: The source contrasts known bounds for TtP constructions with invertible decryption feedback with the noninvertible-feedback cases. It identifies keyed Sponge Duplex and Ascon as examples for which bounding μ_T was left open for future research.
citation_labels: Bishwajit Chakraborty et al., Exact Security Analysis of ASCON
